updates.title: Hide and Seek no longer stuck on Loading map
updates.text: On school and office networks the game could hang on "Loading map..." forever. It now switches to a backup connection after a few seconds and remembers it for that network.

updates.title: Tool names in the map editor
updates.text: Hovering any tool in the map editor now shows its name. Before, the names were cut off by the tool panel.

updates.title: Hide and Seek rules updated
updates.text: The Hide and Seek page now explains the current rules: in Classic a caught player turns orange and is out of the round, in Zombie Apocalypse they become a zombie and join the hunt.
